Priya (CS): Quick alert — OrbitLabs hit an unexpected hosted spend bump this week compared to their commit. Noticed via the weekly checks.
Liam (CS Ops): Seen it. Dashboard shows a 45% week-over-week increase. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/orbitlabs/usage
Priya (CS): Commit is $12k/mo, current burn ~ $17.3k monthly run-rate based on 3 days of spike. That gives a ~44% overage risk.
Noah (Billing Bot): automated alert: ORBITLABS spend_delta = +45% (7d), projected_monthly = $17,300, commit = $12,000. Recommended: contact AE within 24h.
Ava (AE): Thanks — I'm on it. When did the spike start? Any change in error/latency that might cause retries?
Marta (SRE): I pulled logs — 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC we had a transient 2.7x increase in request rate for OrbitLabs route. Error rate unchanged (~0.4%). Latency p50 increased from 120ms -> 190ms for a few hours.
Priya (CS): Copy. So likely traffic surge vs retry storm. Any unusual model rollouts or prompt changes?
Liam (CS Ops): Customer last updated prompt templates on 2026-03-15 per notes from onboarding doc. Could be larger context windows.
Ava (AE): Reaching out to their eng lead @jack to confirm. I'll ask for recent prompt changes and whether they enabled streaming tokens differently.
Priya (CS): Action items: 1) Ava to confirm prompt change (ETA 4h). 2) Marta to pin logs for 2026-03-15..16 and flag any retry loops. 3) Set a temporary spend alert at 20% over commit.
Marta (SRE): Added trace and a small sampling snippet.
Marta (SRE): ```
trace_id: orbit-20260316-9ab4
route: /v1/generate
req_rate_peak: 2.7x
p50_before: 120ms
p50_peak: 190ms
errors: 0.4% (stable)
```
Noah (Billing Bot): alert created: spend-watch-orbitlabs-20pct. Notified @Ava and @Priya.
Ava (AE): Pinged Jack. He says they did a bulk reindex job that triggered extra long prompts with 8x context expansion. Will follow up on expected duration.
Priya (CS): Marking this as 'monitoring' for now. If run-rate stays above commit for >72h escalate to finance for overage conversation.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: rolling-back-model-quant tweak to reduce per-token latency — 2026-03-16T07:12Z :white_check_mark:
Liam (CS Ops): Noting for weekly recap. I'll add a short blurb to the account health doc and flag potential renewal conversation if this repeats.
Ava (AE): Thanks team. I'll update OrbitLabs and share customer impact notes after I hear back. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): Thanks — closing the thread for now, will reopen if spend stays elevated or if customer reports production impact.
